[BUG-01] Dashboard shows OCCUPIED for a room that has not sent any reading
Description:
A room with no readings in the database is shown with the green OCCUPIED badge, so the operator cannot tell an occupied room from a room whose sensor node is offline.

Found by: Exploratory testing of the dashboard; reproduced by TC_UI_01 in run1-initial
Severity: Minor

Steps to reproduce:
1. Start the server with a new database: python -m app.server --db data/new.db
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:8090 in the browser
3. Select room CR-201 (no reading has been posted for it)

Expected: State badge shows NO DATA (FR-2.2)
Actual: State badge shows OCCUPIED

Resolution: Fixed - RoomMonitor.status() now reports NO_DATA until the first frame is received; the dashboard shows the NO DATA badge (app/engine.py).
Retest: TC_UI_01 PASS in run2-retest

Priority: Medium

Summary: [BUG-02] False AC_ON_VACANT alert when the mean temperature drop is just below the threshold
Description:
The mean drop was rounded to 2 decimals before being compared with delta_t_threshold, so a drop of 0.499 deg C became 0.50 and the AC was reported ON in a room where it is off.

Found by: TC_M1_21 (BVA: threshold - 0.001) in run1-initial
Severity: Major

Steps to reproduce:
1. Settings: vacancy_frames=5, wait_seconds=60, delta_t_threshold=0.5
2. Send 2 occupied frames, then 5 empty frames with all regions at 25.0 deg C
3. 60 s after vacancy is confirmed, send an empty frame with all regions at 24.501 deg C

Expected: ac_inferred_on=False, no alert (mean drop 0.499 < 0.5, FR-1.6)
Actual: ac_inferred_on=True and AC_ON_VACANT alert raised

Resolution: Fixed - the comparison uses the unrounded mean (rounded to 6 decimals only to remove floating-point noise); 2-3 decimal rounding is kept only for display (app/engine.py).
Retest: TC_M1_19, TC_M1_20, TC_M1_21, TC_M1_22 PASS in run2-retest

Priority: High

Summary: [BUG-03] API returns 404 'Room None not found.' when room_id is missing
Description:
A reading posted without room_id is treated as a lookup of a room called None. The status code and message hide the real problem from the sensor-node developer.

Found by: TC_M2_04 in run1-initial
Severity: Minor

Steps to reproduce:
1. Start the server
2. POST /api/readings with a valid frame body that has no room_id field

Expected: 400: room_id is required. (FR-2.1)
Actual: 404: Room None not found.

Resolution: Fixed - a missing or empty room_id is rejected with 400 'room_id is required.' before the room lookup (app/server.py).
Retest: TC_M2_04 PASS, TC_M2_03 still PASS in run2-retest
